title: Associate Creative Director
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
 At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.
 Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
 Read our blog to learn more.
 About the role...
 Duolingo’s Brand Campaigns team creates culture-first ideas that earn attention, strengthen our brand, and inspire people to learn. We’re looking for an Associate Creative Director (art) to develop and deliver integrated campaigns that are unmistakably Duolingo. As a senior individual contributor, you’ll combine hands-on concepting with creative direction. You can turn brand strategy, cultural insights, and business goals into compelling work across social, video, experiential, out-of-home, partnerships, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Brand Campaigns, Social, Product Marketing, PR, and global teams to guide ideas from brief through launch while maintaining a highest standard of craft.
 🧠 You will...
 Develop original concepts and creative platforms for integrated brand campaigns, partnerships, product launches, and cultural moments.
 Translate strategy and cultural insights into clear creative territories, narratives, and channel-specific executions.
 Lead creative development from brief through launch, including concepting, presentations, production, feedback, and final delivery.
 Create work directly while guiding designers, writers, animators, filmmakers, agencies, and production partners toward a cohesive vision.

title: Sr. Counsel
location: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
description:
About Pinterest:
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
 We’re looking for an experienced and practical lawyer to join our team supporting our Global Content Organization (GCO). This is a unique opportunity to join a nimble team in a growing organization and work on challenging issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment.
 What you’ll do:
 Serve as the lead lawyer responsible for being the primary lawyer to the GCO organization.
 Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of agreements, including creator/talent, content licensing, development, production, services, sponsorship, collaboration, co-marketing, releases, and media-buying agreements.
 Counsel on topics customarily supported by marketing and content lawyers, such as intellectual property rights, the FTC’s endorsement guides, rights of publicity, licensing, and promotions (e.g., contests and sweepstakes).

title: Senior iOS Engineer
location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
 Instacart is a Flex First team
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
 Overview
 Instacart’s Stores Intelligence organization is building the operating system for brick-and-mortar grocery. As a Senior iOS Engineer on the In-Store Mode team, you will build the mobile experience that helps people shop in physical grocery stores. Customers plan the trip at home, then use the same app in the aisle to find items, discover deals, and use their loyalty rewards.
 What makes the engineering interesting:
 One experience, many apps: In-Store Mode runs inside many grocers' branded apps and blends native iOS with web, so you'll design for flexibility, consistency, and a clear boundary between the two.
 The physical world is challenging: The same feature has to work in a small neighborhood market and a large wholesale store, with very different layouts, assortments, and shopping habits, while powering in-store navigation and discovery.

title: Account Executive, Mobile Gaming
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 We're looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our Advertising Solutions (Quests) team to grow our mobile gaming advertising business. This is a strategic individual contributor role for a performance-minded seller who knows how performance marketers buy: you speak fluently about MMP integrations, CPI and ROAS goals, and how user acquisition teams evaluate a new channel.
 You'll prospect and close new partners, work with growth teams to plan and optimize campaigns, and bring what you learn back to our Product teams to shape how Discord serves performance advertisers.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Drive new revenue: Own a $[XX]M+ annual revenue target across mobile gaming advertisers, from prospecting through negotiation and close.
 Sell performance: Build proposals around advertiser goals like CPI, ROAS, and retention, and help clients set up and read results through their mobile measurement partners (MMPs).
 Build relationships with performance marketers: Develop trusted relationships with user acquisition, growth, and marketing leaders at mobile game publishers and their agencies.
 Bring the market back to Discord: Share client and market insights with Product, Product Marketing, and Measurement teams to shape performance features and ad products.
 Represent Discord externally: Be a voice for Discord in the mobile gaming and app marketing community, at client meetings and industry events, with a focus on protecting the user experience.
 Build repeatable processes: Partner across the sales organization to build scalable processes, forecasts, and playbooks for performance advertisers.

title: Counsel, Patents & IP
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 This position will manage Lyft's patent function — driving the strategy and day-to-day management of our patent portfolio — while also advising on the company's approach to open source, reviewing technical publications before they go external, and serving as a trusted advisor on IP questions across the business. This position will report to the Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, IP. Beyond the legal chops, we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys building relationships — you'll spend as much time with engineers and researchers as you will with lawyers, so a warm, curious, low-ego style goes a long way here. We value people who can make patent law feel approachable rather than intimidating, who bring a sense of humor to a fast-moving environment, and who are as excited about celebrating an inventor's first disclosure as they are about closing out a tricky filing decision. This is a great opportunity for someone to come in and manage the patent function at Lyft, working on cutting-edge issues spanning Lyft's global expansion, Lyft Urban Solutions' mobility hardware and software business, and supporting the deployment and expansion of autonomous vehicles on Lyft's network.
 Responsibilities:
 Own the patent portfolio end to end for the company — invention harvesting, invention disclosure meetings, portfolio mining, and directing patent application preparation and prosecution by outside patent counsel.
 Drive patent strategy and drive filing, continuation, and abandonment decisions based on technical merit, competitive landscape, and cost, and own portfolio health and reporting against product roadmaps.
 Counsel and collaborate with engineering on open source license review and approval for inbound and outbound open source, including license compatibility and compliance risk.
